plaatsen.tekst: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
